doc.brief: Describes limits of a [`EventController`](xref:gtk:EventController) for handling events targeting other widgets.
doc.md:
Describes limits of a [`EventController`](xref:gtk:EventController) for handling events
targeting other widgets.

none.brief: Events are handled regardless of what their target is.
none.md:
Events are handled regardless of what their
  target is.

same_native.brief: Events are only handled if their target is in the same [`Native`](xref:gtk:Native) (or widget with [`Widget:limit-events`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#property:limit-events) set) as the event controllers widget.
same_native.md:
Events are only handled if their target is in
  the same [`Native`](xref:gtk:Native) (or widget with [`Widget:limit-events`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#property:limit-events)
  set) as the event controllers widget.
  Note that some event types have two targets (origin and destination).
